channel.description: Latest articles from European Medical Journal (emjreviews.com)

item.title: COVID-19 Vaccination Recommended for Immunocompromised Patients
item.description: COVID-19 vaccination is strongly recommended for immunocompromised patients for the 2025–2026 season, according to new guidance. The post COVID-19 Vaccination Recommended for Immunocompromised Patients appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Cognitive and Neuropsychiatric Function in Former Football Players
item.description: Former American football players showed poorer cognitive and neuropsychiatric function, with symptoms worsening by exposure level. The post Cognitive and Neuropsychiatric Function in Former Football Players appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Thyroid Cancer Overdiagnosis at Up to 94% in Past Decades
item.description: An estimated 72 to 94% of cases were overdiagnosed in the USA between 1991 and 2019, according to a 2026 study. The post Thyroid Cancer Overdiagnosis at Up to 94% in Past Decades appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Cancer After Cardiac Surgery Linked to Shorter Survival
item.description: Cancer after cardiac surgery was tied to shorter long-term survival, even though in-hospital mortality remained low. The post Cancer After Cardiac Surgery Linked to Shorter Survival appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: USA Newborn Hepatitis B Vaccination Rates Dive
item.description: HBV vaccination rates among infants in the USA have fallen by more than 10 percentage points in the past two years. The post USA Newborn Hepatitis B Vaccination Rates Dive appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Targeting Hidden HIV Reservoir Clones for Future Cure Strategies
item.description: Study dissects HIV reservoir clones that persist on ART, revealing how CD8+ T cells and resistance pathways could be harnessed for future cure strategies. The post Targeting Hidden HIV Reservoir Clones for Future Cure Strategies appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Photonic Sensor Improves Cervical Cancer Detection
item.description: A temperature tested photonic crystal sensor achieves over 91% accuracy in cervical cancer screening using label free optical detection. The post Photonic Sensor Improves Cervical Cancer Detection appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Untreated Sleep Apnoea: A Hidden Multi-Billion Hit to Productivity
item.description: Obstructive sleep apnoea may affect 1 in 5 adults in the UK and USA, costing billions in lost productivity, but can be offset by effective treatment. The post Untreated Sleep Apnoea: A Hidden Multi-Billion Hit to Productivity appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Fasting Mimetic Improves Cardiometabolic Health
item.description: Mimio reduced total cholesterol, LDL cholesterol, LDL particle number, oxidised LDL, non-HDL cholesterol, and fasting glucose. The post Fasting Mimetic Improves Cardiometabolic Health appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Malaria In Pregnancy Drives Maternal Anaemia Burden
item.description: Modelling across seven African countries shows malaria in pregnancy remains a major cause of maternal anaemia, with over 2 million cases projected in 2023. The post Malaria In Pregnancy Drives Maternal Anaemia Burden appeared first on European Medical Journal.
